gate.plain: Rules are tuned only on older data (in-sample). They are then judged ONCE on later months they never saw. Only that unseen result counts.
At least 200 trades in total (weekly and intraday strategies). Monthly strategies (≤ 1 trade per monthly expiry): at least 100 trades and ≥ 20 in the unseen months (amended 26-Oct-2026).
Real NSE/BSE/Groww prices. Synthetic (MODELED, Black-Scholes) results never count.
Positive after Indian charges (STT, exchange, SEBI, stamp, GST) and still positive at 2× slippage (cost stress 0.5% / 1.0% / 1.5%).
t-stat ≥ 3 and deflated Sharpe > 0.95 using the TRUE number of variants ever tried (≈ 600 now), so lucky winners from a big search are filtered out.
Walk-forward (6-month train / 1-month test, rolled monthly) must be positive; probability of backtest overfitting (PBO) < 0.3; neighbours within ±20% of each setting must also work.
Monte-Carlo 95th-percentile drawdown < 25% of capital; positive in ≥ 60% of calendar quarters; margin must fit the capital.
